name: Crate Box
description: A 2x2 wooden crate sealing four boxes, which only breaks when boxes of its OWN color are popped next to it.
howToPlay: Each crate shows its color and holds four boxes. Tap three matching-color boxes anywhere around its 2x2 footprint to smash it open, then tap the boxes inside. Wrong-colored neighbours just thud against the wood.

showcaseLevel.name: Crack the Crates
showcaseLevel.desc: Three same-color taps free the four boxes inside
